The sum of the areas of all layers is
$$ \sum_{i=1}^{853} A_i = \sum_{i=1}^{853} 2^{853-i} \cdot 950 = 950 \sum_{i=1}^{853} 2^{853-i} = 950 \sum_{j=0}^{852} 2^j $$
